notes.title: We are planning to release Dungeon Crusher Kiritan for Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
We are planning to release Dungeon Crusher Kiritan for Nintendo Switch!
(In 2021 Autumn)

Thanks for all your help!

To celebrate this, the demo is available for about a week!

Thanks!

Kaifu

notes.title: Added "Delete Save Data" button & Bug fix
notes.notes:
Small update

- Added "Delete Save Data" button in the title scene
- Removed Secret "Delete Save Data" command in the title scene instead
- Fixed the game stopping issue when the scene loaded


Great thanks to 落雪鸦杀(@rakusetsuasatsu)

Kaifu

notes.title: Update (ver. 0.5)
notes.notes:
Main update points:  (ver. 0.4 → ver. 0.5)


- Improved all levels
- Improved explore mode game rules
- Improved the tutorials
- Added the transform gauge auto regain
- Added hold move buttons to go straight automatically
- Added some effects
- Fixed bugs


Thanks,
